english: Good, the enemy formation's broken.\nPush through all at once!
I'll open the way! Everyone, follow me!
Leading the charge onto the battlefield...\npulling everyone forward...\nlike a famous general from the Thirty Kingdoms, desuu!
Thirty Kingdoms?\nDunno what that is,\nbut I AM a captain who leads troops.
If I don't lead from the front, nobody follows.\nThat's what a captain is.
It's not as grand as Laura,\nbut I'm a club president, y'know!
I see, desuu...\nthis is leadership, this is charisma...
Now that it's decided, time to put it into practice, desuu!
H-huh? Nobody's following...\neveryone, what's wrong, desuu?
Hmm, hate to say it,\nbut I don't think it's for you...
You're more of the...\nbeing-led type, I think.
Sorry... it's a matter of aptitude...
Cruel as it sounds,\nit's a captain's duty\nto tell you sooner rather than later...
D-don't be so down!\nThat's it! Being led is a talent too!
Th-that's right!\nEveryone has their own role!
That's right!\nYou're right! Got it!\nI'll do my best, desuu!
Alright! Now! Everyone!\nLead me to your hearts' content, desuu!!\nCome on! Come on!
Ow!? Ow ow!! It hurts, it hurts!!\nLaura-san! Mion-san!\nDon't pull my hair, desuu!!
Ahaha, sorry sorry!\nThis old man meant no harm...\nor so I'd like to say...
Geez...\nmy twintails aren't for pulling, desuu~.
Huh? Mion-san...\nthat collar-looking thing behind your back...\nwh-what is it, desuu...?
